name: Floating Platform, Hut
desc1: Through a small doorway you enter a large room, walls cluttered with
desc2: the prized portions of a number of different water creatures. A long
desc3: bench sits near the back wall, with a massive wooden tub of water
desc4: behind it. In the tub sits a merman smiling warmly at you while
desc5: polishing a huge clam shell. A well crafted ladder allows passage down
desc6: through a small open trap door beside the counter.
